subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairsare alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) NR - MQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d23313634072d215371edd9e6930d37ae925f14c4fbc5209bc1db31bf72f9c.png] 

Option 2) EI - DH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/565981b5ca49da1032fc6e2df6094faaeb61bc4800d5ed3c76aa2fa020be2a44.png] 

Option 3) XZ - TL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/518bb50668723c7afcbf6b163a56fff6bc3285e9ec9ec0a03fa38a2fa25a0cfe.png] 

Option 4) RV - QU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c53a7edf8def56a80e06b2dd089c738d7765ee729572d5f364b94c3a39a0b7c.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'XZ - TL' is the odd one.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
